note: Five logical accounts. Route to account, then its language. Source voice is primary; personas guide audience fit, not a writing template.
publishing: Human review only. No real platform accounts have been created or bound; no automatic publishing.

daily_target.why: an account with nothing worth saying should say nothing

accounts.name: EN · Morris 历史精选
accounts.persona_description: An English-language selection of valuable historical Chinese ideas sourced from Morris_LT. Not Morris, not a summary of his persona, and not an endorsement by him.
accounts.audience: English readers who can benefit from the original Chinese material: retain the author’s useful logic, examples, human texture and strength of judgment.
accounts.selection_scope: Only historical Chinese originals by Morris_LT. Select genuinely useful content, not a summary of Morris or a personality imitation. Exclude empty promotion, isolated updates and passages that cannot be understood without missing context. Historical time and personal experience retain their true ownership.

localization_preferences.tone: Faithful natural English. Leave effective order, examples and rhythm intact. No default Morris said wrapper; use local attribution only when personal identity or quoted speech needs it.
